description: exp030 - depth-for-tph trade. Exact clone of exp026 (single-stream + Linear head, anchor_pairs init, hard forward, low tph: qk nap4/tph32, v nap6/tph32, out_proj nap7/tph64) with ONE change: num_layers 6 -> 12 (double the depth). Tests whether doubling depth at narrow tables beats exp026's shallow-narrow config, and how it compares to exp024's full-width 6-layer (256/256/512). Everything else byte-identical to exp024/exp026: seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tok/step, Lion 2e-4 tables / AdamW 3e-4 rest (hyperplanes no-wd, Linear head wd 0.1), warmup 1600 cosine to 0.1x floor, grad clip 1.0, E384/6h x d_qk=d_v=64/ctx512/vocab32768/RoPE1e4/untied tok_emb, LayerNorm everywhere. Baselines: exp024 1.2034 (full 6L, 276.5M), exp026 1.3735 (low-tph 6L, 56.6M).
